summary: PROCEPT BioRobotics filed an 8-K on September 24, 2026, reporting entry into a Third Amendment to its Loan and Security Agreement with Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, dated September 23, 2026. The amendment extends the Term Loan Maturity Date by 12 months, from October 1, 2027 to October 1, 2028. All other terms, including affirmative and negative covenants, remain unchanged. No equity, ownership, or change-of-control terms are involved. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch for any future covenant relief or incremental borrowing that could signal liquidity pressure.
